title: Transcript
description: STT output for a span of call audio.

call_id.description: Call this transcript belongs to (correlation ID).

is_final.description: True for a finalized utterance, false for an interim/partial result.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 language tag, e.g. en-US.

start_ms.description: Optional start offset within the call, in milliseconds.

end_ms.description: Optional end offset within the call, in milliseconds.
